slice: Booking lifecycle B1 — complete an accepted trip after its last day

ci.note: GitHub Actions backlog; local tests, typecheck, eslint, build and acceptance ran before deployment

database.change: booking_requests.status accepts completed; kinnso_creator_complete_booking(uuid) completes only the owning creator's accepted trip whose last day has passed

deployment.changed: creator PATCH accepts status=completed and maps trip_not_finished to 409; creator inbox Completed filter + Mark trip completed; traveller tracker Completed label

production.step: production creator inbox exposes the completed filter and renders its accepted rows
production traveller tracker loads with the completion-capable API

honestLimits: Completion does not notify the traveller (no new notification type was introduced); it is visible on their tracker.
There is no automatic completion: a creator must mark each finished trip.
The two production accepted rows predate this slice and are left for owner-led cleanup; completing them was not exercised in production to avoid mutating owner data.
